notes: AcontextToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 named Acontext (ACON) with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints all 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the launch factory. There are no application contracts or initialization calls. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
